key_insight: CRC-HGD is a new labeled histopathology image dataset designed to help AI models grade colorectal adenocarcinoma across three WHO differentiation grades and four magnifications.
clinical_relevance: By providing organized multi-scale training data, the dataset may support more reliable automated tools for pathology workflows and cancer prognosis research.
method: Collected 1,914 H&E-stained microscopy images from 214 colorectal adenocarcinoma patients.
Assigned labels using WHO grading: Grade I (106), Grade II (75), and Grade III (33).
Included four magnification levels for each specimen: 4x, 10x, 20x, and 40x.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a dataset of 1,914 images from 214 patients, but no model performance or external validation results are presented.
watch_item: The class distribution is imbalanced, especially for Grade III, which may complicate model training and fairness.
paper_title: CRC-HGD: A Histopathological Image Dataset for Grading Colorectal Cancer
